name: unreal-development-handbook-for-codex
description: Teach durable Unreal Engine development reasoning from intent and architecture through validation and production readiness.

interface.shortDescription: Design and validate Unreal projects before implementation.
interface.longDescription: Bundles a 17-chapter, progressively loaded handbook plus intent-first, design-first, and validation-first skills for Unreal gameplay, worlds, content, Blueprint and C++, automation and procedural systems, production quality, AI-assisted development, and evidence-backed case analysis. It complements Unreal Editor Skills for Codex without bundling editor control or MCP operations.
defaultPrompt: Turn an Unreal feature request into a decision-ready design and validation plan.
Review an Unreal architecture for ownership, lifecycle, and production risks.
Define evidence and quality gates before implementing an Unreal workflow.
